Hi Rina / Kenji —

Thanks again for stopping by the booth outline yesterday. I'm landing in Tokyo tonight and want to lock in a short 25-minute live demo while I'm on-site. Below are a few windows that should work from my side — I included the explicit time conversions to avoid the usual DST/hotel-clock mixup: 

- Wed Sep 2, 11:00–11:25 JST (Wed Sep 1, 19:00–19:25 PDT, Wed Sep 2, 04:00–04:25 CEST)
- Wed Sep 2, 13:00–13:25 JST (Wed Sep 1, 21:00–21:25 PDT, Wed Sep 2, 06:00–06:25 CEST)

If neither window works, tell me the concrete time on your side (JST or local) and I will convert. I'm traveling so my phone will likely stay on my US profile — the hotel clocks in this area sometimes get set to the event's “display” time which caused me to miss a slot last year.

Attached: demo_deck_v3.pdf (high-level). If you confirm a slot I will send a calendar invite with agenda and a regional endpoint so we run the demo from APAC.

Thanks — look forward to it.

— Sergio

Thanks — that helps. Quick note: our ops person on-site only has a 30–45 minute break at 11:15 JST because of booth duty. The rest of the attendees will join remotely: one engineer will dial in from Amsterdam (CEST) and a product manager from Melbourne (AEST).

Also FYI — the hotel front desk set the public clocks on the 12th floor to event time (they left them at UTC for some reason), so my colleague initially read the room time wrong. Apologies if hotel clocks cause any confusion.

If you confirm I will block the room and Kenji will coordinate the on-site check-in.

Best,
Rina
